review.en: Made in the spring of 1966, as the Beatles were about to stop touring, Revolver treats the studio as an instrument. Tape loops and a droning single chord drive the closing track, a string octet carries Eleanor Rigby, and George Harrison contributes three songs including the opener. Fourteen short songs, nearly every one a new idea.
review.zh: 1966 年春天录制，披头士正要告别巡演，开始把录音室当成乐器。终曲靠磁带循环和单一和弦推进，《Eleanor Rigby》只用弦乐八重奏伴奏，哈里森也贡献了三首歌，包括开场曲。十四首短歌，几乎每一首都是一个新主意。
